lead_headline: Restaurant closures accelerate with Syrup Cherry Creek (16 years), Church and Union Denver (2 years), and Table 6 (22 years) all shuttering within days

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead: Recess Tivoli opens at Auraria Campus this month. 16 closures detected including Church and Union Denver (LoDo), Table 6 (22 years), Park Burger Highlands (15 years).

liquor.blurb: 1 application Friday: Que Bueno Mexican Grille (DIA concourse BC-22) applies for hotel/restaurant license, flagged delinquent on arrival. Single status upgrade: The Patio at Sloans clears delinquency to active. Week closes at 3 applications vs. prior week's 267 — post-purge baseline confirms 5-8 weekly cadence as liquor board's administrative backlog dump recedes into rearview. Three-license week represents cleanest read on normal filing velocity since multi-month queue cleared last Friday.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Friday pushes citation blackout to 17 consecutive days — longest monitored silence in outlet's tracking history. All-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 sources since August 5. Past 30 days: 56 mentions (down from 68 yesterday as July citations expire). 17-day void now exceeds every prior holiday gap, summer lull, and editorial cycle in multi-year dataset — either syndication infrastructure collapsed, monitoring system broke, or fundamental shift in industry citation behavior occurred mid-August with zero warning signals.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +5 yesterday (6 new, 1 canceled) as Friday acquisition holds steady with minimal churn drag. MTD advances to +21 (+1.0/day) while 90-day net climbs to +92. Past 7 days: +33 net (47 new, 14 canceled) vs. prior week's +3 — thirty-subscriber gain powered by acquisition acceleration (47 vs. 21 new) and tightened churn discipline (14 vs. 18 cancels). Recent fortnight shows clean momentum reversal: Week 1 crawled to +3 on modest flow, Week 2 surges to +33 as new-subscriber pace doubles and cancellation rate drops 22%. August escapes early-month weakness as YTD trend (+238, +1.0/day) confirms structural stability beneath weekly swings.
